items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: My mother's name was Georgia Turner.

ctx.x: Ah, Joe, let's go back to Kansas City for a minute, and we never got the names of your mother and father. Would you tell me their names, please.
Well, my daddy's name was Joe Turner. I'm Joe Turner, Jr.. My mother's name was Georgia Turner.
And what was her name before she got married?
